test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The anchor gave us a ______ welcome, a pleasant smile and a bouquet on reaching the hotel.
solution:
The correct answer is **warm**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A warm welcome:** A hearty, hospitable reception or greeting.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 1**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Worth: **having a particular value (in money). 
 
• **Winning: ** the act of a person or thing that wins.
 
• **Wonderful: **extremely good; fantastic.
